title: 第76章 京城齐家，惊动高层
content_zh:
第76章 京城齐家，惊动高层-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

下一章

方志远的声音清晰，会议室的空调声都被压下去了。

矮胖工作人员迈进门，手里那份文件举到齐胸的高度，红章正对着所有人。

"浦东新区经济和信息化委员会产业审查科，关于张江高科技园区三号研发楼入驻项目的合规性补充调查通知。"

他念了一遍文件抬头，清了清嗓子。

"鉴于群众举报，入驻项目方经营资质存疑，根据相关规定，在调查结论出具前，涉及该项目的一切签约及备案流程暂停执行。审查期不少于三十个工作日。"

会议室的空气凝了一层霜。

方锐脸上的血色肉眼可见往下褪。

他下意识看向叶知秋，叶知秋没看他，目光落在林川身上。

齐衡的钢笔还停在协议封面上方。

陈启明在旁边翻开手里的尽调报告又合上，目光看向来人，神态轻松。

方志远站在门口，双手背在身后。

目光从会议桌扫过去，在齐衡脸上掠了一下——他仍然把这个人当成一个临时搭壳公司的小角色。

"各位也不要紧张。"方志远的声调往下压了半分，

"合规调查是正常流程。查清楚了，该签继续签。上面的意思，也是对投资者负责。"

这话说出来，在场的人心里都清楚——三十天审查期，拖到黄花菜凉。

方锐的喉结动了一下，有些紧张，他从成都飞来的红眼航班，文件签名签了三遍，不会黄了吧。

他撑了两秒，嘴唇动了动，想说什么。

"文件给我看看。"

林川的声音从签字位传出来。

不急不慢。

矮胖工作人员愣了一下，下意识看了方志远一眼。方志远微微点了下头。

文件递了过去。

林川接过来，翻到首页。看了五秒。

翻到第二页，又看了几秒。然后合上，放在桌面上。

"三个问题。"

他抬头，看着矮胖工作人员。

"第一。文件抬头是产业审查科，签章也是审查科。这个级别的合规调查通知，出具之前需不需要经过经开委分管领导会签？"

矮胖工作人员张了张嘴。

"我看文件签发栏只有一个科室主管的名字。"林川的手指点了一下纸面。

"第二。群众举报。举报人是谁？举报内容是什么？按照规定，被调查方有权了解举报事由。文件里没有附件。"

矮胖工作人员的手缩回去一寸。

"第三。"

林川的视线从文件上移开，看了方志远一眼。

"这份文件今天下午送到现场。签发日期写的是昨天傍晚。产业审查科出具调查通知正常走行政流程，从立案到出文至少三天。"

他把文件往桌上一推。

Fang Zhiyuan's voice was so clear that the sound of the air conditioner in the conference room was suppressed.

The short and fat staff member walked through the door, holding the document in his hand to chest height, with the red seal facing everyone.

"Pudong New Area Economic and Information Technology Commission Industrial Review Section, Notice of Complementary Compliance Investigation on the No. 3 R&D Building in Zhangjiang High-tech Park."

He read the document once, looked up, and cleared his throat.

"In view of reports from the public, the business qualifications of the parties settled in the project are questionable. According to relevant regulations, all signing and filing procedures related to the project are suspended until the conclusion of the investigation is issued. The review period will be no less than thirty working days."

The air in the conference room was frosty.

The blood on Fang Rui's face could be seen fading to the naked eye.

He subconsciously looked at Ye Zhiqiu, but Ye Zhiqiu didn't look at him, his eyes fell on Lin Chuan.

Qi Heng's pen still stopped above the cover of the agreement.

Chen Qiming opened the due diligence report in his hand and closed it again, looking at the person coming with a relaxed expression.

Fang Zhiyuan stood at the door with his hands behind his back.

His eyes swept across the conference table and glanced at Qi Heng's face - he still regarded this person as a small role in the temporary shell company.

"Don't be nervous, everyone." Fang Zhiyuan lowered his tone by half a minute.

"Compliance investigation is a normal process. After the investigation is clear, the signature should be continued. The above meaning is also to be responsible to investors."

When these words were spoken, everyone present knew it in their hearts - the thirty-day review period would last until the day lily is cold.

Fang Rui's Adam's apple moved and he was a little nervous. He had signed the document three times on the red-eye flight from Chengdu, so it wouldn't be yellow.

He held on for two seconds and moved his lips, trying to say something.

"Show me the file."

Lin Chuan's voice came from the signing position.

Take your time.

The pudgy staff member was stunned for a moment and glanced at Fang Zhiyuan subconsciously.Fang Zhiyuan nodded slightly.

The document was handed over.

Lin Chuan took it and turned to the homepage.I watched it for five seconds.

I turned to the second page and read it for a few seconds.Then close it and place it on the table.

"Three questions."

He looked up at the squat staff member.

"First. The document is headed by the Industrial Review Section, and the signature is also by the Review Section. Does a compliance investigation notice at this level need to be counter-signed by the leader in charge of the Economic Development Committee before it is issued?"

The pudgy staff member opened his mouth.

"I see that there is only one name in the document issuance column." Lin Chuan tapped the paper with his finger.

"Second. Report from the masses. Who is the reporter? What is the content of the report? According to regulations, the party under investigation has the right to know the reason for the report. There are no attachments in the document."

The stocky staff member retracted his hand an inch.

"Third."

Lin Chuan looked away from the document and glanced at Fang Zhiyuan.

"This document was delivered to the scene this afternoon. The date of issuance was written yesterday evening. The Industrial Examination Section issued an investigation notice and followed the normal administrative process. It takes at least three days from the filing of the case to the issuance of the document."

He pushed the file onto the table.
